context: A uni student helps a teen friend process a horror story she wrote
purpose: Teach: 如く/無縁/作り出し/奪っ/残酷/幽霊/徒然/題し

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、私の短編、「冷たい部屋」と題した話、読んでもらえました？
lines.en: Senpai, did you get a chance to read my short story? The one I called 'The Cold Room'?
lines.style: Tentative, almost holding her breath. Slightly rushed at the start—trying to sound casual and failing. A small catch of hope underneath the nerves.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 読んだよ。冒頭の幽霊の描写、本当にぞくっとした。
lines.en: I did. That opening description of the ghost—it really got under my skin.
lines.style: Genuine warmth. Leans forward slightly with the compliment. Not performing encouragement, but meaning it. Eyes bright with actual engagement.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 人の命を残酷に奪っていく描写、書きすぎかなって不安なんです。
lines.en: I keep worrying the part where she takes those lives—the cruelty of it—maybe I pushed too hard.
lines.style: Vulnerability breaking through. Quiet and tentative, testing whether he'll think less of her for the darkness. Trailing off slightly, searching his face.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いや、緊張感を作り出してて良かったよ。徒然に書いた感じじゃない、ちゃんと構成されてた。
lines.en: No—it actually builds this perfect tension. Doesn't read like you were just throwing it together. It's carefully put together.
lines.style: Firm reassurance, not dismissive. Speaks like he's thought about this. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone who knows what real craft looks like.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ジャンルとは無縁だった私が、こんな話書けるとは思わなかった。
lines.en: I never thought someone like me—with zero horror experience—could actually pull off something this dark.
lines.style: Surprised at herself. A note of pride breaking through the disbelief. Slight laugh of recognition, like she's seeing herself differently now.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: プロの如く、しっかり感情を引き出す筆致だった。続編もぜひ。
lines.en: Your writing drew emotion out exactly like a professional would. You have to write a sequel.
lines.style: Direct conviction. No hedging. Leans back slightly, giving her space to land it. The tone of someone passing a torch, not just handing out praise.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます！書きます。
lines.en: Thank you so much. I will.
lines.style: Bright and clear. Relief and determination in equal measure. Sits up straighter. The sound of someone who just decided something.
